en: An illustrated postcard showing a large three‑masted sailing ship at sea under full sails. The vessel flies a Scandinavian-style ensign at the stern and a blue flag with a white Nordic cross (and a small red canton) at the main masthead. Smaller sailing vessels and a red lightship or buoy tender appear in the background. The artwork is in a classic marine‑painting style, with the ship's name and captain captioned along the bottom margin.
